title: Setting up the Excel Add-In for Editing Data

facts.text: Microsoft Entra ID must be configured for authentication of the server instance, clients, and users.
OData must be enabled and use Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) for authentication.
Web server must be configured to use SSL (https) for secure connections.
Client computers must have a supported version of Excel installed.
Expose the Business Central Web API in Microsoft Entra ID by setting the Application ID URI on the Expose API page.
Register a separate Microsoft Entra application for the Excel add-in and add optional claims for email and upn.
Configure the server instance by setting Excel add-in client ID, Web Client Base URL, OData Base URL, and enabling OData and API services.
The add-in enables the Edit in Excel action on list pages, allowing users to push changed data back to Business Central, unlike the basic Open in Excel action.
